rejections.name: Input power
rejections.reason: 2.5W is the charger rating in the guide's recharge-time table ("64h 2.5W"), not the GBX155's input power.

rejections.name: Química de la batería
rejections.reason: The guide says the GBX155 is only for 12-volt lead-acid batteries, which is the vehicle's battery; its own battery is lithium-ion.
